central_college_scholarship: The Central Sector Scholarship for College & University Students is open to anyone currently enrolled as a student, provided their total annual household income is ₹4,50,000 or less.
post_matric_sc: The Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students is open to students who belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category, provided their total annual household income is ₹2,50,000 or less.
pmay_urban: PM Awas Yojana (Urban), for the EWS/LIG category, is open to households living in an urban area who do not already own a residential house, provided their total annual household income is ₹6,00,000 or less.
pm_kisan: PM-KISAN Income Support is open to farming households, provided no member of the household pays income tax.
karnataka_gruha_lakshmi: Karnataka's Gruha Lakshmi scheme is open to women who are the head of their household, resident in Karnataka, provided no member of the household pays income tax.
